n_g relaxes toward n_g* = (Q_in − S)/c with the artificial τ_g = 30 ns (the physical V/c is 221 µs): the transient is a numerical device, only the fixed point is physical. The dashed line is the zero-ionisation ceiling n_g0 = Q_in/c.

Energy ledger

Residual = Δ(K+U) − (injected − absorbed − inelastic + born-ion kinetic energy + electrode work) per interval, where electrode work = Σ V_k (ΔQ_induced,k − q_absorbed,k) is the energy the 300 V supply delivers. What remains is the momentum-conserving scheme's numerical non-conservation (grid heating / self-force with finite particles per cell); it is reported, not hidden.
